BL-791 — EPIC — Bring the extension unit suite back under 13 seconds, and keep it there
What it solves: ## Prior art this epic must not repeat
Approval context: Your 2026-08-03 absolute-priority request, specced. Firm, because you said it: under 13s, no deleted tests, no dropped coverage, no raised budget, profile before cutting.

Two calls of mine that need your eye.

(1) **Slice A measures before slice B cuts.** I know you asked for a number, not a repor…
BL-791 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-791" (or "reject BL-791 <reason>") to act.
